nodes.label: A7 Activate Membership Screen
nodes.rationale: First-time enrolment surface, reached from the 'Have an invitation code?' link on A5. Eyebrow 'ACTIVATE MEMBERSHIP', headline 'Welcome, Privilege Guest', subhead 'Use the code from your welcome email'. The header band is compressed (hero ends at y 147 vs 195 on A5/A6) to make room for the tallest card in the set, which stacks invitation code, mobile number, a rule, notification toggles and the commit button. Carries a back button like A6.

nodes.label: Invitation Code Field (PG-XXXX-XXXX)
nodes.source_location: activation card, first field, gold focus outline
nodes.rationale: Masked format hint 'PG-XXXX-XXXX' teaches the code shape before typing; the 'PG' prefix encodes Privilege Guest. Given the gold focus outline as the first and highest-priority field on the screen, while the mobile field below it sits in the neutral resting state - the code is what gates entry.

nodes.label: Enrolment Mobile Number Field
nodes.source_location: activation card, second field with helper text
nodes.rationale: Same split +974 control as A5, annotated with the helper line 'This becomes your sign-in method.' The copy makes the enrolment step explicitly bind the phone number as the permanent identity for all later sign-ins, explaining why no password is ever requested.

nodes.label: Notification Channel Preferences
nodes.source_location: activation card, below hairline rule; Email and SMS toggle rows
nodes.rationale: Two toggles separated from the credential fields by a hairline rule. Email ships on (gold, knob right), SMS ships off (grey, knob left) - marketing consent defaults to the channel the invitation already arrived on, and leaves the transactional SMS channel unclaimed for promotional use. Collected during activation rather than deferred to a settings screen.

nodes.label: Activate Membership Action
nodes.source_location: activation card, primary gold pill at card foot
nodes.rationale: Primary CTA committing code, phone number and channel preferences in a single submission.

nodes.label: Already Activated? Sign In Link
nodes.source_location: below the activation card, gold text link with caret
nodes.rationale: Return route to A5, mirroring the 'Have an invitation code?' link in the opposite direction. The pair makes sign-in and activation mutually reachable so a guest who lands on the wrong surface is never stuck.

nodes.label: Invitation-Only Membership Enrolment
nodes.rationale: There is no open sign-up anywhere in the flow - the only way to become a member is to redeem a PG-prefixed code issued out of band in a welcome email. Membership is a closed, hotel-issued privilege rather than a self-serve account, which is what licenses the 'Welcome, Privilege Guest' greeting before any identity has been verified: the design assumes anyone holding a code is already known to the property.
